evidence_quote: The speed is halved for every 100 additional people, so for 200 people (which is 100 additional people), the speed is halved.
question_evidence_quote: For every 100 additional people that board a spaceship, its speed is halved.
observed_error: The response applies only one halving to the increase from 200 to 400 people.
violated_condition: Adding 200 people comprises two increments of 100 people, each requiring a halving.
error_description: The response treats the increase from 200 to 400 people as requiring only one halving of the 500 km/hr speed. That increase contains two groups of 100 additional people, requiring two successive halvings. The division by 2 is executed correctly; the number of halvings is wrong.
